title: Yoda 桌面端周期同步扇出审计
description: Yoda 是 App Runtime Audit 的首个校准案例。在不终止会话或删除资源的前提下，把长运行卡顿与 task inventory、完成事件、task 级 IPC、Git remote 读取和 tmux 资源图连接起来；案例数字不作为其他客户端的默认预算或门槛。

items: 实际运行的 Yoda desktop build 与历史源码调用链
最大已挂载项目的一次 task records 现场 inventory
canonical tmux server 的一次 session 现场 inventory
一次周期同步完成事件及其 task 级处理路径
补丁后下一次 8-remotes 同步的高频进程采样

prompt: 审计 Yoda 桌面端越用越卡的放大链，固定 platform_family=desktop、runtime=electron，区分有边界的现场 inventory、源码事实、近似推导和后续测量，画出 task、terminal、tmux、process 与 worktree 的资源关系；不要执行清理，也不要把 Yoda 数字泛化成阈值。

items: 资源图：project → task → terminal/session → PTY/tmux → process，以及 repository → worktree
有边界的现场 inventory：最大已挂载项目 916 条 task records；canonical tmux server 61 个 sessions
近似模型：916 task records × 每 task 1 次 IPC ≈ 916 IPC
近似模型：约 916 RPC × 每 RPC 2 次 Git remote 读取 ≈ 1,832 Git subprocess work items
后续测量：8-remotes 同步约 4 秒内 600 samples，观察到 15 个 unique Git subprocess，peak concurrency 5

evidence.statement: 最大已挂载项目的一次只读 inventory 包含 916 条 task records，其中 33 active、883 archived。

provenance.sample_window: single read-only aggregate of the largest mounted project
provenance.sampler: runtime database inventory grouped by archived_at

evidence.boundary: Largest mounted project only; this is not a count for every Yoda project or a runtime-store measurement.

evidence.statement: canonical tmux server 的一次只读 inventory 包含 61 个 sessions。

provenance.sampler: tmux -L yoda list-panes inventory and descendant process graph

evidence.boundary: Session count only; it does not classify any session as leaked, idle, orphaned or reclaimable.

evidence.statement: 历史完成事件沿 resident-task 路径逐项处理，并进入 task 级 remote read。

provenance.build_ref: Yoda pre-change source path; exact baseline commit was not retained
provenance.observed_at: source review during the historical Yoda audit

evidence.statement: 约 916 IPC 来自 task inventory 与历史逐项刷新路径的乘法模型，不是直接 trace 计数。

provenance.build_ref: Yoda pre-change source path; exact baseline commit was not retained
provenance.observed_at: derived during the historical Yoda audit

inputs: one task-level IPC per resident-task path from yoda-per-task-refresh-path
derivation.formula: 916 task records × 1 IPC per task path ≈ 916 IPC
assumptions: all inventoried task records were resident consumers for the modeled event
the modeled completion event matched the project and scheduled one refresh per consumer
derivation.falsifier: A trace of the pre-change build shows a bounded project-level request or fewer task-level calls.

evidence.statement: 约 1,832 Git subprocess work items 来自两层源码乘法模型，不是直接进程 trace 计数。

provenance.build_ref: Yoda pre-change source path; exact baseline commit was not retained
provenance.observed_at: derived during the historical Yoda audit

inputs: two repeated Git remote reads per modeled RPC
derivation.formula: approximately 916 RPCs × 2 Git remote reads ≈ 1,832 subprocess work items
assumptions: each modeled RPC reaches both historical remote-read call sites
overlapping completion events and cache effects are excluded from the estimate
derivation.falsifier: A pre-change process trace or command instrumentation observes bounded work that does not scale with task count.

evidence.statement: 补丁后的下一次 8-remotes 同步观察到 15 个 unique Git subprocess，peak concurrency 为 5。

provenance.sample_window: 600 samples at 100 ms across 8 remote synchronizations; approximately 4 seconds active
provenance.sampler: macOS process inventory filtered to Git descendants

comparison.note: The baseline is inferred work items while the later value is a unique runtime process count under a post-change workload; the report must suppress an exact delta.

threshold_context.threshold_source: No Yoda product threshold was declared for this audit measurement.

threshold_policy.statement: Yoda case values calibrate evidence semantics only. Every target App must declare its own workload, sampler, SLO and threshold.

boundaries: 没有把 61 个 tmux sessions 自动判为泄漏、孤儿或可回收资源
没有执行 kill、worktree remove、缓存重置或递归目录删除
916/61 是 2026-08-09 的有边界 inventory；保留了审计日期但没有墙钟时刻
约 916/1,832 是 inference；15 是后续 measurement，不能计算精确 delta 或百分比
Yoda 的任何数字都不是 Electron、桌面端或其他客户端的通用 threshold
